paragraphs.text: Not only physical descendants, but of a far greater multitude by faith, Ro 4:17.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: The changing of his name is a seal to confirm God's promise to him.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: Circumcision is called the covenant, because it signifies the covenant and has the promise of grace joined to it: a phrase that is common to all ordinances.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: That private part is circumcised, to show that all that is begotten by man is corrupt, and must die.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: Though women were not circumcised, they still partook of God's promise: for under mankind all was consecrated. Here it is declared, that whoever condemns the sign, also despises the promise.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: Which proceeded from a sudden joy, and not from lack of faith.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: The everlasting covenant is made with the children of the Spirit. A temporary promise is made with the children of the flesh, as was promised to Ishmael.
paragraphs.label: g

paragraphs.text: They were well taught if they obeyed and were circumcised without resistance. This teaches that masters in their houses ought to be as preachers to their families, that from the highest to the lowest they may obey the will of God.
